summary: Completed comprehensive testing of JWT-based authentication system. All 10 requested features PASSED. Backend auth APIs fully tested (24 pytest tests), frontend auth UI flows verified with Playwright. Data isolation between users confirmed both at API and UI level.

minor.issue: JWT secret key warning: 31 bytes < recommended 32 bytes (non-blocking)

auth_screen.description: Shows LOG IN / SIGN UP tabs with email + password inputs

signup_flow.description: Create new account with email/password/name, redirects to home page after successful registration. NAME field appears in SIGN UP mode.

login_flow.description: Log in with existing credentials (userA@test.com/test123), redirects to home page showing user name 'Coach A'

login_wrong_credentials.description: Wrong credentials show 'Invalid email or password' error message in red

auth_gating.description: Without login, user sees auth screen (not home page). _layout.tsx gates on user auth.

home_page_user_info.description: Shows user name (e.g., 'Coach A') in top-left and logout button (icon) in top-right after login

data_isolation.description: User A creates team 'TEST_UserA_Team'. User B (different account) does NOT see User A's team. Verified both via API (backend tests) and UI (Playwright).

logout_flow.description: Clicking logout button (testID='logout-btn') returns to auth screen. Token cleared from AsyncStorage.

api_protection_teams.description: GET /api/teams without auth token returns 401 'Not authenticated'

api_protection_matches.description: GET /api/matches without auth token returns 401 'Not authenticated'

categories: TestAuthEndpoints (10 tests): register, login, duplicate email, wrong password, /me endpoint
TestAPIProtection (6 tests): teams, matches, player-stats, player-notes require auth
TestDataIsolation (5 tests): users cannot see/update/delete each other's teams/matches
TestAuthenticatedCRUD (2 tests): create/get teams with auth
TestHealthEndpoint (1 test): health check no auth required

scenarios: Auth screen display with LOG IN / SIGN UP tabs
Sign up flow with NAME field and redirect
Login flow with redirect to home
Logout flow returning to auth screen
